subject: 临安功臣塔
source_note: 2009年照片，近正面兼侧立面，底层局部被树遮挡；重绘保留五层、矩形开口与砖仿木轮廓，底部仅补简洁台基。
author: Dirrival
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. All other images are SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY; never draw the Buddha. Create refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line art. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; doors and windows are outlines, never black fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, hatching, texture, pencil grain, gradient, color or gold. The white will become transparent and the ink uniformly gold on the website. Show complete architecture centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Only a few short ground lines. Remove people, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences and unrelated buildings. Selectively preserve architectural ornament without tracing every roof tile or brick. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, caption, watermark, frame or border. Subject: Gongchen Pagoda 功臣塔 in Lin'an, Zhejiang; the actual ancient square FIVE-STOREY brick tower in photo 2. Exactly five tall square wall storeys, each with a single central tall rectangular opening and subtly outlined engaged brick columns. Thin stepped brick cornices between levels, no sweeping Chinese tiled roof tiers. A low pyramidal masonry cap and double-gourd iron finial. Preserve observed proportions: slim tall tower with only gentle taper. Draw almost straight on, correcting camera tilt; show small sliver of side face only. Photo foliage obscures ground: remove foliage and complete the plain lowest storey and simple plinth consistently. Portrait 1024×1536, full tower 82% image height with equally generous blank side margins, base and finial fully inside. Draw each cornice using TWO OR THREE contour lines only. Absolutely no brick courses, masonry joint grids, dense horizontal stripes or weathering. Internal structural lines should be at most 20% as numerous as the photograph; elegant contour sketch, as sparse as the style master.
verification: Five storeys, complete apex/base; restrained line-only surfaces.
